entities.summary: Andrei Olgertovich Volozhinsky is an officer of the Russian Navy. He holds the rank of vice-admiral, and has most recently served as the First Deputy Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Navy and Chief of the Main Staff of the Navy, between 2016 and 2019.
